jobSpec.command:
cd /data && mkdir qwen2-vl

cp /mnt/ca-p800-poc/llava-en-zh-300k.tar.gz /data/qwen2-vl/
#cp /mnt/ca-p800-poc/llava-en-zh-2k.tar.gz /data/qwen2-vl/
cd /data/qwen2-vl

tar -zxvf llava-en-zh-300k.tar.gz && rm llava-en-zh-300k.tar.gz
#tar -zxvf llava-en-zh-2k.tar.gz && rm llava-en-zh-2k.tar.gz

# code
cp /mnt/ca-p800-poc/models/qwen2-vl.tar.gz /home/
cd /home/
tar -zxvf qwen2-vl.tar.gz && rm qwen2-vl.tar.gz

# model weights
cp /mnt/ca-p800-poc/Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct.tar.gz .
tar -zxvf Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct.tar.gz && rm Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct.tar.gz

#train lora
cd /home/qwen2-vl/
conda activate llamafactory_env
export PATH=/root/miniconda/envs/llamafactory_env/bin:$PATH
export PYTHONPATH=$PYTHONPATH:/home/qwen2-vl/

apt-get install dnsutils -y
pip install deepspeed==0.14.5

source env.sh
nohup bash dist_train.sh lora &

sleep 100000
